Load the packages

using DataFramesMeta

using Statistics

using ColorSchemes
using StyledStrings
using SummaryTables
using PairPlots
include(joinpath(@__DIR__,"table-one-mod.jl"))
include(joinpath(@__DIR__,"pairplot-with-regression.jl"))
include(joinpath(@__DIR__,"boxplot-with-stats.jl"))
include(joinpath(@__DIR__,"coerce_string_columns.jl"))
include(joinpath(@__DIR__,"eta-corr.jl"))
include(joinpath(@__DIR__,"gof.jl"))

Main.Notebook.sessioninfo

Initialize the dataset and result directories

# Set relative paths to directories (start from the project folder)
proj_dir = string(chomp(read(`git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, String))) # Get the root git folder
pumasai_repo = basename(realpath(proj_dir))
data_dir = joinpath(proj_dir,  "datasets")
results_dir = joinpath(proj_dir, "results")
sdata_dir = joinpath(data_dir, "source")
ddata_dir = joinpath(data_dir, "derived")

# Specify the Quarto file specific directories
qmd_dir, qmd_name = splitdir(@__FILE__)
qmd_prefix, _ = splitext(qmd_name)
task_results_dir = joinpath(results_dir, basename(realpath(qmd_dir)))
qmd_results_dir = joinpath(task_results_dir, qmd_prefix)
mdl_dir = joinpath(qmd_dir, "pumas")
julia_fns_dir = joinpath(qmd_dir, "julia-functions")

# Specify the qmd relative path to program and default source info
qmd_relative_path = lstrip(split(@__FILE__, pumasai_repo)[end], '/')

# Initialize results directory
# include(joinpath(utils_dir, "init-dir.jl"))
# init_dir(joinpath(qmd_results_dir))
"\\programs\\Plots\\plot-adppk.qmd"

Specify text strings to be used as program and source references in footnotes to tables and figures created by this Quarto program.

# Text specifying relative paths to program and default source info
# Program path
prog_ref = string("Program: ", qmd_relative_path)

# Relative path to Source path: QMD HTML 
qmd_html = string(qmd_prefix, ".html")
qmd_html_path = joinpath(
    dirname(qmd_relative_path),
    qmd_html
)
qmd_html_ref = string("Source: ", qmd_html_path)

# Specify relative path to the QMD results directory
# This should be used to construct the Source reference for TLFs
qmd_results_path = replace(qmd_relative_path, "programs" => "results")
"\\results\\Plots\\plot-adppk.qmd"

Setting Plots theme

my_theme = Theme(
    Axis=(
        yminorticks=IntervalsBetween(2),
        yminorgridvisible=true,
        xminorticks=IntervalsBetween(2),
        xminorgridvisible=true,
        xlabelfont=:bold,
        ylabelfont=:bold,
        leftspinecolor=:gray60,
        rightspinecolor=:gray60,
        topspinecolor=:gray60,
        bottomspinecolor=:gray60,
    )
)

my_log_theme = Theme(
    Axis=(
        yminorgridvisible=true,
        xminorticks=IntervalsBetween(2),
        xminorgridvisible=true,
        xlabelfont=:bold,
        ylabelfont=:bold,
        leftspinecolor=:gray60,
        rightspinecolor=:gray60,
        topspinecolor=:gray60,
        bottomspinecolor=:gray60,
        yscale=log10,
        yminorticks=IntervalsBetween(10),
        ytickformat=x -> string.(round.(x, digits=1)),
    )
)

set_theme!(my_theme)

Load the data

path = joinpath(@__DIR__ ,"..","..","datasets","derived")
adppk = CSV.read(
    joinpath(path, "adppk.csv"),
    DataFrame
)
adppk = filter(:COHORTC => !=("Placebo"), adppk)
first(adppk,5)

Tabular Summary of Subject Characteristics

# Baseline characteristics
# Note: Missing row appears only when there are missing values
adata_subj = unique(adppk, :USUBJID) # Subset to one row per subject (USUBJID)
table_one_mod( # bespoke function table_one_mod - renders Total column in the last. Use table_one to get it in the front.
    adata_subj,
    [
        :SEX => "Sex",
        :AGE => "Age [yr]",
        :WTBL => "Baseline Weight [kg]",
        :BMIBL => "Baseline BMI [kg/m²]",

Correlation between covariates


pair_plot = @chain adppk begin
    @select :STUDYIDN :USUBJID :AGE :BMIBL :EGFRBL :WTBL # select only covariate data & unique identifiers
    unique # filter to keep only unique
    @select :AGE :BMIBL :EGFRBL :WTBL
    @rename begin # Renaming the columns
        $("Age [yr]") = :AGE
        $(:"BMI [kg/m²]") = :BMIBL
        $(:"eGFR [mL/min/m²]") = :EGFRBL
        $(:"Weight [kg]") = :WTBL
    end
    dropmissing

    # The following function is defined in 20-poppk/julia-functions/pairplot-with-regression.
    # Regression Line with CI Band is not available in PairPlots.jl
    pairplot_with_regression(
        color=:royalblue3,
        title="Correlation between Continuous-Valued Covariates",
        subtitle="CDISCPILOT01",
        size=(800, 800)
    )
end

Visualize Covariate Distributions

Continuous variates

# Creating a Layer
dist_layer = @chain adppk begin
    @select :STUDYIDN :USUBJID :AGE :BMIBL :EGFRBL :WTBL # select only continuous covariate data & unique identifiers
    unique # filter to keep only unique
    @rename begin # Renaming the columns
        $("Age [yr]") = :AGE
        $(:"BMI [kg/m²]") = :BMIBL
        $(:"eGFR [mL/min/m²]") = :EGFRBL
        $(:"Weight [kg]") = :WTBL
    end
    stack(_, [:"Age [yr]", :"BMI [kg/m²]", :"eGFR [mL/min/m²]", :"Weight [kg]"])
    dropmissing

    data(_) *
    mapping(
        :value,
        layout=:variable,
        color=:variable,
    )

end
Layer 
  transformation: identity
  data: AlgebraOfGraphics.Columns{DataFrames.DataFrameColumns{DataFrame}}
  positional:
    1: value
  named:
    layout: variable
    color: variable

blq_smr = @chain adppk begin
    @transform(:NFRLTC = @. string(round(:NFRLT, digits = 2)))
    @rsubset :EVID == 0
    @groupby :NFRLTC
    @combine begin
        :N = length(:DV)
        :NBLQ = sum(:BLQFN)
        :"BLQ [%]" = round(sum(:BLQFN) / length(:DV) * 100, digits = 1)
    end
end

total_n = sum(blq_smr.N)
total_nblq = sum(blq_smr.NBLQ)
total_pc_nblq = round(sum(blq_smr.NBLQ) / total_n * 100, digits=1)

# Formatting the TOTAL row to bold and making a DataFrame
blq_tot_smr = DataFrame([
    :NFRLTC => [styled"{bold:Total}"],
    :N => [styled"{bold:$total_n}"],
    :NBLQ => [styled"{bold:$total_nblq}"],
    Symbol("BLQ [%]") => [styled"{bold:$total_pc_nblq}"]
])

@chain vcat(blq_smr, blq_tot_smr) begin
    @rtransform begin
        :NBLQ = :NBLQ == 0 ? "-" : :NBLQ
        :"BLQ [%]" = :"BLQ [%]" == 0 ? "-" : :"BLQ [%]"
    end

    simple_table(
        [
            :NFRLTC => Annotated("Nominal Sampling Time [hr]", "Relative to previous dose", label="a"),
            :N => Annotated("N", "Number of Samples", label="b"),
            :NBLQ => Annotated("NBLQ", "Number of BLQ samples", label="c"),
            Symbol("BLQ [%]")
        ],
        halign=[:left, :right, :right, :right]
    )
end

rug_nfrlt =
    mapping(unique(pdata_smr.NFRLT)) *
    visual(VLines; color=:red, ymin=0, ymax=0.05, linewidth=1)

median_layer =
    data(pdata_smr) *
    mapping(
        :NFRLT,
        :DVP50
    ) *
    visual(Lines)

dn_median_layer =
    data(pdata_smr) *
    mapping(
        :NFRLT,
        :DNDVP50
    ) *
    visual(Lines)

median_grouping =
    mapping(
        color=:TXA => sorter(unique(pdata_smr.TXA)),
        linestyle=:TXA => sorter(unique(pdata_smr.TXA))
    )

layout_by_TXA =
    mapping(layout=:TXA => sorter(unique(pdata_smr.TXA)))
Layer 
  transformation: identity
  data: Nothing
  positional:
  named:
    layout: :TXA => AlgebraOfGraphics.Renamer{CategoricalVector{Union{Missing, String}, UInt32, String, CategoricalValue{String, UInt32}, Missing}, Vector{String}}(Union{Missing, CategoricalValue{String, UInt32}}[missing], ["missing"])

Median C-T Profiles

with_theme(my_log_theme) do
    median_ct_plot =
        (
            median_layer * median_grouping
            +
            lloq_line
            +
            rug_nfrlt
        ) |>
        draw(
            figure=(
                title="Median Observed Concentration vs Time, by Dose Level",
                subtitle="CDISCPILOT01",
                size=(800, 600)
            ),
            axis=(ylabel="Plasma Concentration [ng/mL]",
                limits=(nothing, nothing, nothing, nothing)
            ),
            legend=(
                position=:bottom,
                nbanks=2,
                framevisible=false,
                titlesize=0
            )
        )
end
